schema:alternativeHeadline: Scan page 22 of Magpie of California, no. 2, vol. 10. A person in a checked shirt leans over a seated bare-chested person holding a folder or document. A smiling person in light-colored clothing sits with one leg crossed, one arm resting on a chair. Several people gather around a movie camera on a tripod; one peers through the viewfinder. Two people sit close together, one smiling toward the other with an arm around the shoulders.
